entities.name: Nicolò Sagredo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolò Sagredo was the 105th Doge of Venice, reigning from 6 February 1675 until his death less than two years later. Little of note occurred during his reign as Venice was still recovering from the Cretan War (1645–1669), which had ended during the reign of his predecessor.
